decisions.title: Ratify Vault-native JSON as the Founder OS state store
decisions.context: Founder OS needs persistence. The repository is an Obsidian Vault with a Python toolkit and no application runtime, database, or web stack. This session implemented state as one git-versioned JSON document inside the Vault, written only by the toolkit CLI, with Markdown and HTML as generated read-only mirrors.
decisions.recommendation: Ratify Vault-native JSON for V1 and revisit only when concurrent multi-writer access is genuinely required.
options: Ratify Vault-native JSON (no new runtime, no secrets, git history is the audit log)
Introduce a hosted database and web application now
Defer and keep operating from Markdown dashboards
decisions.consequence_of_delay: The Console persists work but its foundation stays unratified, so later layers risk being built on a contract the Founder never accepted.
decisions.decision_note: Ratified by the Founder 2026-08-31. Vault-native git-versioned JSON is the Founder OS state store for V1. Revisit only when concurrent multi-writer access is genuinely required. Implementation merged in PR #12 (cd1f637).

decisions.title: Keep the Founder Console local-only
decisions.context: Console V1 runs as a file you open directly or a loopback server on 127.0.0.1. It has no authentication because it is not reachable off-host. Any hosted deployment would expose Founder state and require an authentication system that does not exist in this repository.
decisions.recommendation: Keep local-only for V1. Treat hosting as a separate decision that must ship with authentication.
options: Host privately with authentication built first
decisions.consequence_of_delay: Low. Local-only is the safe default and blocks nothing today.
decisions.decision_note: Ratified by the Founder 2026-09-01. Console V1 stays local-only: file:// and a 127.0.0.1 loopback server, no authentication because the socket is not reachable off-host. Verified loopback-only (refused on the host interface IP). Any hosted deployment is a separate decision that must ship an authentication system first. Selected 2026-09-04: private static-file delivery through iCloud Drive/Files sync; no public hosting, exposed loopback server, repository credentials, or second state writer.

decisions.title: Authorize OMI credentials for the capture pipeline
decisions.context: Section 11 describes an OMI recording -> transcript -> classification -> routing pipeline. No OMI credential, adapter, or API client exists in this repository, and provisioning one crosses the new-secrets autonomy boundary.
decisions.recommendation: Defer until the routing proof passes. Build the OMI adapter against the ContextItem contract only after one lane is proven.
options: Defer until the routing proof passes
Authorize credentials now and build the adapter
Drop OMI from the Founder OS roadmap
decisions.consequence_of_delay: Low for now. Voice-captured decisions keep landing outside Founder OS until it is built.
